Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614521 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (inner join) and activities, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614521. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
